episode.standalone_story: A Surrey resident seeks help for a persistent cough and learns that inactive MSP may make the visit chargeable.

character_states.wardrobe: Plain teal clinical scrub top and trousers with a lightweight warm-grey cardigan; no badge, logo or readable text.
character_states.knowledge: Understands clinic intake and MSP status but cannot quote the final visit charge.
character_states.objective: Triage Daniel safely and explain administrative uncertainty without shaming him.
character_states.emotional_state: Calm and professionally attentive, becoming carefully apologetic at the coverage result.

character_states.wardrobe: Muted olive field jacket over a charcoal crew-neck shirt and dark trousers; no logo or lettering.
character_states.knowledge: Knows his cough has persisted but does not know his MSP is inactive or what the visit may cost.
character_states.objective: Get assessed without losing control of an unknown expense.
character_states.emotional_state: Tired but stable, then quietly unsettled by the unknown charge.

supplemental_sources.use: open circulation, bright neutral exposure and legible public-to-staff service zoning
open-area scale and reception zoning only; explicitly exclude its glass enclosure, signs and decals

approved_cinematic_style_references.use: facial texture, readable eye light, intimate performance naturalism and non-advertising close-coverage behaviour; do not copy its square crop
wide composition, muted teal-neutral colour restraint, practical spatial depth and paired staging; do not copy its underexposed faces or incomplete workstation

reference_brief.preservation_policy: Match the supplied South Surrey clinic design language closely while omitting facility identity, logos and readable signs.
high_weight_anchors: bright contemporary South Surrey urgent and primary care interior
turquoise confined to three distinct portal-like triage bay frames and partial partitions surrounded by pale neutral walls
pale acoustic-tile ceiling and pale clean flooring with airy neutral daylight
separate waist-high light-maple modular desks inside the triage bays with open space between stations
broad unobstructed public circulation, a central aisle, small teal-and-neutral waiting-chair clusters and a clearly legible open patient-to-staff service plane with no glass divider
functional_layout_checks: the monitor base is fully supported on the staff worktop, its screen faces Amrit, and its centreline is naturally aligned with her operating position
the keyboard sits directly in front of and on the same usable axis as the monitor, within Amrit's comfortable reach
the compact BC Services Card reader sits beside the keyboard within Amrit's reach and near the handoff edge without blocking the keyboard, card path, monitor, or either person's body
the staff worktop is wide and deep enough for all three devices with clear separation, while the public-to-staff handoff plane and clinic circulation remain unobstructed
prohibited_substitutions: glass divider, glazed partition or transparent barrier between patient and nurse
monitor turned away from the nurse, monitor base at an edge, keyboard misaligned with its monitor, or card reader placed across the keyboard or handoff path
readable facility names, logos, patient information or monitor text

sound_plan.ambience_kind: one persisted final amalgamation of faint low mechanical clinic room tone and independently scripted clinic-specific reception conversations, rendered distant, overlapping and semantically indistinct; component noise or chatter stems are disposable after mix verification
sound_plan.opening_region: continuous ambience under the 4-second establishing master
pause_regions: through the silent Care Card handoff
sound_plan.outro_region: continuous clinic-specific background chatter and room tone through the full 3.5-second final reaction
sound_plan.ambience_only_target: mean above -50 dBFS; approximately -38 to -30 LUFS short-term by ear
foley: one soft plastic card slide at the transfer point
prohibited_ambience_sources: synthetic white, pink or brown noise presented as human chatter
foreground-intelligible background speech competing with the principals

edit_policy.planned_native_reframing_rule: A deliberate 16:9 editorial reframe may create closer coverage only when its native-landscape source remains recorded in lineage and every complete face, hairline, chin and shoulder contour stays safely inside the result.

essential_action.completion: The same card finishes face-down on the staff side before Amrit checks coverage.
essential_action.privacy_rule: The card face remains down, edge-on, moving, occluded or defocused throughout.
